test_title: PYST 36: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The car hit the pole beside the shop before the accident.

options.text: The pole beside the shop were hit by the car before the accident.
The pole beside the shop was hit by the car before the accident.
The pole beside the shop had been hit by the car before the accident.
The pole beside the shop hit by the car before the accident.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The pole beside the shop was hit by the car before the accident.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In order to convert an** active sentence to a passive sentence**, we need to make the object of the active sentence the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• In this case, the object of the active sentence is **"the pole beside the shop".**
 
• The subject of the active voice **'the car' **will become the object of the passive voice.
 
• We also need to use the appropriate form of the verb **"to be" **and the past participle of the main verb **"hit". **
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Therefore, the correct passive sentence is** *"The pole beside the shop was hit by the car before the accident." *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1** is incorrect because "were" is not the correct form of the verb "to be" to use with "pole".
 
• **Option 3 **is incorrect because "had been hit" implies that the action happened before another past action, which is not the case in this sentence.
 
• **Option 4** is incorrect because it is not a grammatically correct passive sentence.
